title: rpt finding record
description: One finding in a report. Schema version 3. Unknown members are allowed and must be passed through unchanged.

id.description: Finding ID; assigned by rpt finding add when absent.

targets.description: Where the finding was found, each attributed to a scope row. A finding in a report needs at least one; rpt validate checks them against scope.csv.

severity.description: A severity level from the report config, e.g. critical, high, medium, low, info.

path.description: Path of the finding file, relative to the report root.

rev.description: The finding file's revision, over its bytes as stored. Opaque: compare it, never compute it. Pass it back as --if-rev so a write is refused if the file changed since this read.

sections.description: Markdown per section: description, remediation, poc, plus any other ## heading under its exact text.

evidence.description: Evidence file paths, relative to the finding file's folder. Untrusted: must stay inside the report.

assets.description: Every file the finding lists or links: set by rpt finding get --assets and by rpt assemble. rpt finding add copies each in and rewrites its references; never written to the file.

asset.description: One file the owner lists in its evidence or links in its text. rpt finding add and rpt page add read ref and file only: they copy file into the report and point every reference to ref at the copy.

ref.description: The path as the owner writes it, relative to its file, or absolute.

path.description: Relative to the report root; absent when ref leaves the report.

file.description: The file itself: an absolute path, or for add one relative to the folder add runs in.

source.description: frontmatter: the evidence list; body: a link or image in the text. One asset per source and ref.

media_type.description: From the file's extension, else its content.

position.description: A place in a file: the 1-based line, and the 1-based byte in that line.

lines.description: Where a record's parts sit in its file: 1-based lines of the file as stored, given by --lines and ignored by add. Each record sets the members that apply to it.

file.description: The file's absolute path, in the form rpt opened the report by, symlinks not resolved.

keys.description: Where each top-level frontmatter key (or rpt.yaml key) sits, unknown keys included.

sections.description: A finding's sections, keyed like sections.

body.description: The line a page's body starts on.

row.description: The line a scope row starts on.

sectionLines.description: Where one section sits. Line text+n is line n+1 of the section's text.

text.description: First line of the section's text, surrounding blank lines left out; absent when the section is empty.

target.description: One place the finding was found on, attributed to a scope row. In a report scope is always set. A parser plugin, which doesn't know the scope, sets host instead, and rpt scope match fills scope from the most specific matching row.

scope.description: The ID of the scope row the target falls in.

row.description: The scope row itself, in an assembled report.

host.description: Where inside a range row (a CIDR or *.domain) the finding is. Absent: the whole row, or a row that is one asset. Not allowed with a row that is one asset.

port.description: Must equal the row's port when the row has one.

protocol.description: Must equal the row's protocol when the row has one.
